name: Word Grid
hook: One grid of letters. Two minutes. Find more words.
how: Everyone gets the same grid of letters. Drag across touching letters to make words of 3 or more: longer words score more, but a word someone else found too scores only half at the end.
controls: Drag across the letters with the mouse or a finger; on a keyboard you can also type a word and press Enter
uses: One player's browser deals the grid, runs the clock and adds up the scores; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot players hunt for words alongside you until enough people join.
Everyone's word count and points climb on every screen as they play.
Change the grid size (4×4 or 5×5) or the round length for every room without touching code.
ideas: Make it a 5×5 grid with a 3-minute round
Add a bonus tile that doubles the word it's in
Show a fireworks burst when someone finds a 7-letter word
